newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising in moderate turnover.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising in moderate turnover.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may rise slightly on Tuesday, but turnover is likely to be moderate, brokers said.
"Share prices are expected to rise slightly in moderate trading. Investors are just returning from Eid holidays," said broker Mostaque Ahmed.
He said underpriced scrips like Bata Shoe, Bangladesh Oxygen and Beximco Pharma may attract investors.
The DSE all-share price index closed 6.94 points or 0.53 percent up at 1,127.09 on a turnover of 26.1 million taka on Monday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
